basic_details.short_information: National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (CSIR NEERI) has officially released a notification for the recruitment of 1 Senior Project Associate Posts. This recruitment drive offers a great opportunity for candidates looking for government jobs. Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the official website.

qualification.details: Senior Project Associate: B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized University AND 3 years experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CSIR NEERI Senior Project Associate Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 30-07-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSIR NEERI to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CSIR NEERI Senior Project Associate Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 30-07-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSIR NEERI to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR NEERI Senior Project Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Senior Project Associate position at CSIR NEERI is 30th July 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Project Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E. / B.Tech degree in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized university and have at least 3 years of experience in Research and Development.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Project Associate position is 40 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules, which can be found in the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Project Associate role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 42,000/- per month, plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Project Associate post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Senior Project Associate position in this recruitment drive by CSIR NEERI.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the CSIR NEERI Senior Project Associate recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided information, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Senior Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The selection process for this role will be based on an Online Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Senior Project Associate is on a contractual basis. This means the employment is for a fixed term as per the project requirements.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification PDF and the online application link in the "Important Links" section of this article. The official website of CSIR NEERI is also provided for further reference.
